title: Yemen: Fighting escalates around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait
summary: Fighting is escalating in Yemen after Iran-backed Houthi forces seized strategic territory around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, prompting counterstrikes by government forces and reported Saudi air raids.
